originals.ko: 네가 내 커피를 만들어 주지 않으면
네가 사지 않으면
originals.why: Here wnei di is only the helper verb 'do' (if you don't buy). This course teaches the LEGO as 만들어 주지 않으면 'make for me', so this is the wrong sense.

originals.ko: 네가 안 하면 나는 어떻게 하는지 물어볼 거야
originals.why: Here the LEGO is the elliptical helper 'if you don't'. It does not mean the 'make' sense this course teaches, and the Korean cannot point to one answer.

topups.why: Fixed the Korean: 것 같아 added a hedge ('I think') that the Welsh does not have.
Here os na wnei di rywbeth reads as 'if you don't do something', which is not the 'make' sense. 'Life isn't easy if you don't make something' does not make sense.
It is awkward and reads as 'do something'. The Korean ~지 않으면 문제가 아닐 거야 is also unnatural.
The meaning is odd: 'do you think she could help if you don't make something'. The LEGO reads as 'do something'.
